final: WITH patient_avgs AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) AS patient_alb, AVG(1.0 * l.UN / NULLIF(l.`T-BIL`, 0)) AS patient_un_tbil_ratio FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_avgs AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(patient_alb) AS avg_alb, AVG(patient_un_tbil_ratio) AS avg_un_tbil_ratio FROM patient_avgs GROUP BY SEX), scored AS (SELECT SEX, avg_alb, avg_un_tbil_ratio, AVG(avg_alb) OVER () AS mean_sex_alb FROM sex_avgs) SELECT SEX, avg_alb, avg_un_tbil_ratio, avg_alb - mean_sex_alb AS alb_above_mean FROM scored WHERE avg_alb > mean_sex_alb
